title: A Nexus
description: Well... you've reached an intersection of two passages, to the north and east, the passage brightens, while the darker hallway continues to the south.
npcs: The newbie monster stands here looking confused.  Kill him!  Kill him!
A creepy little crawling thing is scuttling along the floor at your feet.
items: ( 2) A shiny newbie dagger is lying here looking for a back to stab. ..It has a soft glowing aura!
The corpse of the quasit is lying here.
